Each session costs about 4k tokens to read, so the first page of all 360 sessions is about 1.5M tokens over about 12 agents, and a deep read about 7M.
Based on (ruling): your pick a at 13:19 CST, made on the wrong cost of one agent run. Asked again for that reason only.
Based on (measured): runs at 13:16 and 13:22 CST: 10 auto-mode refusals in about 143 sessions; only the lane force-push recurs. docs/debts/notes.md names 3 more from Nov 1-2 (a gh api CI-run cancel, a send_message on a page grant, a lease push).

Meanwhile: nothing runs.
